verdict.rationale: Keycloak supports OAuth2 client_credentials grant for service accounts (machine-to-machine identity distinct from user credentials), fine-grained authorization policies to scope permissions narrowly, and a token revocation endpoint for instant revocation, which together map well onto giving an agent its own least-privilege identity. However, none of the evidence specifically frames this for AI agents, and there's no documentation on agent-specific workflows, dynamic per-agent provisioning at scale, or short-lived credential rotation tailored to autonomous agents. missing for 10: agent-specific identity provisioning docs, evidence of scoped/ephemeral credential issuance workflows for machine identities, independent validation that revocation is truly instant in production, and any AI-agent-specific guidance or case studies.
